title: 第7章 保住自己的小命第8章 灭杀强敌
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
到底有什么急切的事情，需要用一个传音符。
传音符，也是符咒的一种，价值不菲。
有一点好奇，李凡打开传音符，却是管家的声音，“李供奉，有要事相商，请来西凤商盟分店。”
传音符里，还附有一张简易的地图。
淡淡一笑，李凡这个供奉，可不怎么称职，到现在，都没去过西凤商盟一次。
稍微整理一下仪容，这个举动，对于李凡来说，已经是破天荒了，足以看出他对自己供奉这个身份的重视。
收拾一下自己的东西，细心的查看一遍，发现没有什么遗漏，李凡这才离开小宅子。
西凤商盟在源城的分店，开在另一条修仙大街上。
这条大街，依旧不怎么热闹，只有零零散散的修士，在四下闲逛。
李凡没有耽搁，直奔西凤商盟的店铺。
高大上！
西凤商盟的店铺，明显比其他的店铺，高档一些，甚至比那个老字号店铺，都要显得奢华，和讲究一些。
“贵客，可有……哦，是李供奉吧？”
伙计竟然一下子认出自己。
李凡微微一笑一皱眉头。
“李供奉，千万不要误会，我只是见过你的画像而已。”
伙计赶紧解释，并且立刻通报。
“李供奉，别来无恙！”
管家亲自迎出来。
“管家，我不喜欢我的画像，随意让人欣赏。”

李凡口气不爽的说。
“哦？是老朽处理事情欠考虑，我立刻毁掉画像！”
管家态度还不错。
李凡微微点头，就此揭过，“嗯，管家，不知有何要事？”
“请里面说！”
来到一个单独的房间，管家这才说道，“事情是这样的，我们西凤商盟的一批货物被劫持，是附近有名的一伙匪徒，黑风寨……”
“你等等！”
李凡立刻打断对方的话，“据我所知，黑风寨可是有炼气后期高手坐镇。”
“哦，这个李供奉放心，我们西凤商盟同样有一个炼气后期的供奉，对方不过有三名修士，而算上李供奉，咱们这边是六名修士。
或许，根本不需要李供奉你们出手，对方应该会迫于压力，交出劫持的货物！”
管家解释清楚。
“哦！”
李凡随意的抬头，看向房顶。
“哎，看看老朽的记性，这次的劳务费，是一千灵石，并且还奉上两枚元气丹。”
管家笑着说。
“元气丹？”
李凡问道，他是第一次听说这种丹药。
“哦，这种丹药，虽然属于一品丹药，可是却有突破炼气后期瓶颈的功能……”
“我想想。”
content_en:
What is the urgent matter that requires the use of a transmission symbol?
The transmission talisman is also a kind of talisman and is valuable.
A little curious, Li Fan turned on the transmission talisman, but it was the butler's voice, "Li Gongfeng, if you have something important to discuss, please come to the Xifeng Merchant Alliance branch."
There is also a simple map attached to the transmission note.
With a faint smile, Li Fan is not very qualified as a worshipper. He has never been to the Xifeng Merchant Alliance even once.
This move of tidying up his appearance a little was unprecedented for Li Fan, and it was enough to show that he valued his status as a worshiper.
After packing his things and checking them carefully, Li Fan left the small house after finding that nothing was missing.
Xifeng Merchant Alliance's branch in Yuancheng is located on another Xiuxian Street.
This street was still not very lively, with only a few monks wandering around.
Li Fan didn't delay and went straight to the Xifeng Merchant Alliance's store.
large and luxurious!
The stores of Xifeng Merchant Alliance are obviously more upscale than other stores, even more luxurious and sophisticated than that time-honored store.
"Dear guest, are you...oh, is it Li Chongfeng?"
The guy suddenly recognized himself.
Li Fan smiled slightly and frowned.
"Li Gongfeng, don't get me wrong, I just saw your portrait."
The clerk quickly explained and reported immediately.
"Li Gongfeng, you're fine!"
The butler personally welcomed him out.
"Butler, I don't like my portrait to be admired by others."
Li Fan said with an unhappy tone.
"Oh? It's because I handled the matter carelessly. I will destroy the portrait immediately!"
The butler's attitude was pretty good.
Li Fan nodded slightly and said, "Well, steward, what's the important thing?"
"Please tell me inside!"
After arriving in a separate room, the housekeeper said, "The thing is like this. A batch of goods from our Xifeng Merchant Alliance was hijacked by a well-known group of gangsters nearby, Black Wind Village..."
"Wait!"
Li Fan immediately interrupted the other party, "As far as I know, there are masters in the late stage of Qi refining in Heifeng Village."
"Oh, don't worry about Li Gongfeng. Our Xifeng Merchant Alliance also has a late-stage Qi Refining cultivator. The other party only has three monks, and including Li Gongfeng, we have six monks here.
Perhaps, there is no need for Li Gongfeng and you to take action at all. The other party should be forced to hand over the hijacked goods under pressure! "
The butler explained clearly.
"Oh!"
Li Fan raised his head casually and looked at the roof.
"Hey, look at this old man's memory. The labor fee this time is one thousand spirit stones, and two vitality pills are also given."
the butler said with a smile.
"Vitality Pill?"
Li Fan asked. This was the first time he heard of this elixir.
"Oh, this kind of elixir, although it belongs to the first-grade elixir, has the function of breaking through the bottleneck in the later stage of Qi refining..."
"Let me think about it."
